changes: Tekken splitting with UTF-8 byte offsets and borrowed input pieces; uppercase-run scan reused.

GPT2-family byte mapping uses one call-local append-only string builder. Reset after 64KiB or before a piece exceeds the available reserve. Ordinary reserve capped at 64KiB; a single large piece may exceed that.

model.load: mmap and GGUF metadata parsing only; tensor data not consumed

method.order: alternating reference/offsets versus offsets/reference for split; reference/per_piece/workspace versus workspace/per_piece/reference for encode
method.vocabulary: real Ministral checkpoint vocabulary and BPE merge ranks for encode; same corpus and merge code for all modes
method.correctness: each encode benchmark checks exact token IDs before timing; differential tests additionally cover Unicode, invalid UTF-8 and custom/mutable byte maps
method.reference: frozen original rune splitter and per-piece encode buffers
method.per_piece_control: optimized UTF8 splitter with previous per-piece encode buffers; isolates builder changes
method.workspace: optimized UTF8 splitter plus reusable mapping builder

limits: Component measurements only; no decode, full-generation, STT, RSS or paging speedup claim.
Synthetic prompt text, real checkpoint tokenizer vocabulary; model weight quantization does not participate.
Host background load was not fully controlled.
Bytes/op and allocs/op are allocations, not peak live memory. Borrowed pieces retain the input string while retained by a caller.
The long_unique corpus repeats a 1024-distinct-word block eight times; the mapping optimization does not cache pieces.
